desc.message: On the console case detail page, click "Record supplement" to start recording; a control panel appears in the bottom-right corner.

consoleOrigin.message: Console origin (change to the actual address for cross-machine access)

aiHint.message: Describe the operation to perform; reference page elements with #cssSelector (e.g. recognize image #captchaImg). It is executed live by the AI agent during playback:

pickHint.message: Click the target element on the page (Esc to cancel)...

assertHint.message: Choose an assertion type and fill in the expected value:

assertExpected.message: Expected value (defaults to the element's current text)

invalidJson.message: Expected value is not valid JSON

autoCaptureHint.message: Auto-capture: generates a hover step when the cursor stays on an element ≥500ms during recording (noisy, off by default)

manualHoverHint.message: Manual insert: pick an element on the page to immediately emit a hover step
